meta.description: Query the ChEMBL database for bioactive molecules, drug targets, bioactivity data, approved drugs, and chemical structures. Use when the user asks about compounds, targets, IC50/Ki values, drug mechanisms, or structure searches.

scientific_integrity.detail: Database query skill, returns verified ChEMBL data without fabrication

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope limited to database queries with license notification requirement

methodological_ground.detail: Standard API query patterns, proper normalization for bioactivity comparisons

code_usability.detail: chembl_api.py script syntactically correct with proper error handling

functional_suitability.note: Complete ChEMBL API coverage including search, activity, similarity, substructure queries

reliability.note: Good error patterns documented but lacks explicit retry strategies for API failures

performance_context.note: 284 lines with CLI reference, slightly verbose but organized with progressive disclosure to references

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow section and command examples. Minor: feedback design could specify expected output formats more explicitly

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language for chemical database queries. Clear use cases in description

security.note: License notification mechanism, secure API script patterns. Minor: API key handling not explicitly documented

maintainability.note: Clean script separation, modular subcommands. Lacks formal test cases for API script validation

agent_specific.note: Good composability with UniProt cross-reference. Escape hatches could be more explicit for out-of-scope queries

assertions.note: Calls target search followed by activity query with proper filters
Uses max_phase filter to identify approved drugs
Correctly invokes similarity search with CHEMBL ID and threshold

assertions.text: Uses activity subcommand with target ID
assertions.note: Correctly queries activity endpoint with CHEMBL target ID
Combines standard_type and value threshold filters using ChEMBL filter syntax
Correctly specifies value in nM units
Correctly invokes substructure endpoint with SMILES string
Uses --dl_format sdf to retrieve structure data
Uses target_components__accession filter for UniProt ID lookup
Target query → activity query workflow documented
Uses IDs from previous query results correctly

key_strengths: Comprehensive ChEMBL API coverage with all major query types (search, activity, similarity, substructure)
Strong script-based architecture with chembl_api.py providing consistent interface
Excellent cross-database integration with UniProt accession lookup
Proper license notification requirement ensures compliance
Clear workflow documentation from status check through complex multi-step queries

recommendations.title: Add explicit API retry strategies
recommendations.problem: Script lacks documented retry patterns for transient API failures or rate limiting
recommendations.root_cause: Focus on happy-path API interactions without resilience patterns
recommendations.fix: Add retry logic to chembl_api.py with exponential backoff. Document --retry flag usage in SKILL.md with examples of handling API timeouts

recommendations.title: Document expected output formats
recommendations.problem: While JSON output is specified, schema/structure of returned data not explicitly shown
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes familiarity with ChEMBL API response structure
recommendations.fix: Add example output JSON snippets for each major subcommand showing key fields users should expect (e.g., molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, bioactivity fields)

recommendations.title: Enhance escape hatch documentation
recommendations.problem: When to use alternative tools or databases not explicitly stated
recommendations.root_cause: Skill focuses on ChEMBL capabilities without boundary guidance
recommendations.fix: Add 'When NOT to Use' section: for PubChem use different skill; for internal compound libraries consider alternative tools; for pharmacokinetics use DrugBank
